SUPPORTING PEOPLE: SHEP commenced operations under the control of Jessica Pooley in 2024.  Her aim was to help others less fortunate by providing basic hygiene kits in an easy and accessible manner.
Safe Haven Essential Packs, based in Maylands, Western Australia, is a community initiative providing essential toiletries, personal care to women, families, and individuals in need.
We gather donated items from across the metropolitan area and pack them ready for donation.
The donations are made via a number of local charities with the primary objective of promoting self-care and hygiene for people affected by homelessness and domestic violence.
